text:
kai (eng-release): Starting rollout plan for v2.3.1 — US -> EU -> APAC. canary slice 5% each region.
leah (devops): I pushed the canary manifest to staging, will promote to prod when prechecks pass.
maria (oncall): Reminder: APAC change window is 01:00-05:00 JST, need cooldown rules for after warmup.
deploy-bot: deploy request accepted: release=v2.3.1, slice=canary, regions=[us-east-1]; id=dep-3421
raj (sre): Quick capacity checklist before US canary:
- pods healthy >= 95%
- avg p99 latency < 250ms
- available GPU headroom >= 30%
leah (devops): Running smoke scripts and capacity probe. snippet:```bash
kubectl -n runtime get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o wide
# checking node allocatable
```
ops-runner-bot: capacity-probe result: pods=98% healthy, p99=185ms, gpu_headroom=38%
kai (eng-release): Good. Kick US canary. Pin rollout config: `pin=us:50m,eu:off,apac:off` (will enable eu after US cooldown).
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout in us-east-1 (slice=5%) — dep-3421 -> canary-1
maria (oncall): Watching traces and cost meters. If p99 > 300ms or error-rate > 1.5% for 3 consecutive minutes, we rollback.
raj (sre): Set watchdog: `if error_rate >= 1.5 and duration >= 3m -> rollback-all` — added to ops policies.
leah (devops): Prewarmed nodes in us-east scaled to desired=12 -> ready=12. KV cache primed.
ops-runner-bot: metric spike detector: cpu_surge=normal, qps=within-expected, cache-hit=87%
kai (eng-release): US canary stable at 25m. Proceed to EU prep: replicate warmup scripts, pre-pin eur model variants (quantized) for lower mem.
leah (devops): Note: EU region has tighter GPU quotas overnight. We'll use burst pool fallback to eu-burst if headroom < 20%. Add routing policy: `region_routing: prefer=eu-core, fallback=eu-burst, max_latency_penalty=40ms`.
maria (oncall): For APAC we need a longer cooldown after rollout because traffic patterns spike at 02:00 JST. Plan: APAC canary only after EU stable for >= 45m and manual signoff.
kai (eng-release): Agreed. Rollback decision tree in shorthand:
- transient latency spike (<5m) -> hold and monitor
- sustained >3m & error_rate >1.5% -> rollback canary slice
- sustained across regions or infra degradation -> global rollback to v2.3.0 and trigger incident channel
leah (devops): Pinned image digest for this rollout: `sha256:4b7a...ff12`. Will not accept mutable tags.
deploy-bot: canary progress: 5% -> 25% -> 50% in us-east-1. Next step: EU readiness gate.
raj (sre): EU probe run result: pods=93% healthy, p99=210ms, gpu_headroom=22% -> OK but monitor burst threshold.
maria (oncall): I'm going to be on-call during EU ramp. If we see p95 latency regress >30% notify @kai @leah immediately.
kai (eng-release): Manual gate: leah, give thumbs when EU is green and I'll flip pin to enable APAC window prep.
leah (devops): EU green :thumbsup: prepping APAC warmup scripts, will schedule warmup at 00:30 JST before change window.
ops-runner-bot: scheduled warmup job job-880 at 2100030000 (epoch).
kai (eng-release): Final note: release notes updated with rollback steps, observability playbook, and postmortem checklist. Keep this thread for coordinating final pin and rollback decisions.
maria (oncall): Acknowledged. Staying on call for APAC window.
leah (devops): copying the critical commands here for runbook:
```bash
# rollback to previous version
redwoodctl rollout rollback --release v2.3.0 --regions all --force
# pin a region to old model
redwoodctl pin set --region apac --model v2.3.0
```
raj (sre): If anyone sees any automated rollback triggers firing, ping #incidents and start the postmortem doc template.
kai (eng-release): Thanks all. I'll post a short summary in #eng-releases once APAC goes live or if we need to rollback. :rocket:
